# Annex C - Variable reference {#sec-annex-c}

This annex lists the shared simulation state, the settings, and the EDEN
module fields. Mission scripts can read any `aee_*` variable. The tables
follow the variable names as written in the SQF source.

## Simulation state

### Engine environment bridges

These variables back the local engine bridges (issue #141). Each bridge is
client-only and derives from deterministic state, so none is broadcast.

| Variable | Subsystem | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `aee_atmos_localWindActive` | atmos | True while the rotor-wash visual is applied |

| `aee_mobility_vehicleMassSource` | mobility | Source record id behind a sourced mass estimate |

The soil-strength model is fail-closed (#117). It publishes no numeric VCI or
Mobility Index value while the vehicle records and the VCI50 source are
unverified. Only the two status variables above are active. The numeric
variables `aee_mobility_currentVCI1`, `aee_mobility_currentVCI50`, and
`aee_mobility_currentMobilityIndex` are cleared with nil.

| `aee_ballistics_supersonicTrace` | ballistics | Refractive index contrast across the bow shock, in units of 1e-4. The exact upper bound for every nose shape. The attained maximum for a round with a finite tip radius. 0 when the round is not supersonic. The Fired handler publishes it once at the muzzle. A caller recomputes it at range with the round's current velocity, which is argument 0. A renderer may scale it. The kernel never does |

### Explosions

| Variable | Subsystem | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `aee_fx_blastOverpressureKpa` | fx | Last explosion incident overpressure in kPa (Kingery-Bulmash) |
| `aee_fx_blastInjury` | fx | Last explosion injury vector [eardrum, lungThresh, lung1, lung50, lung99, throw] |
| `aee_fx_particleSources` | fx | Live particle source records: [source, effect, priority, particles, expiry, key, params] |
| `aee_fx_supersonicTrace` | fx | Live refractive shock traces drawn on the local player's rounds. One record per trace, holding the particle source, the projectile, and the last kernel contrast in units of 1e-4. The renderer caps the list at 4 and skips a new shot at the cap. The drawn distortion is an upper bound on the refractive contrast. It is not a vapour trail and not a condensation trail |
| `aee_core_moduleUpdateInterval` | core | EDEN update interval |
| `aee_core_weatherProgressionSeed` | core | Seeded weather progression |
| `aee_core_qnh` | core | QNH pressure setting |
| `aee_core_pressureAltitude_m` | core | Pressure altitude in metres |
| `aee_core_isReady` | core | Core module ready flag |
| `aee_core_lastStrikePos` | core | Last lightning strike position |
| `aee_core_lightningIgnition` | core | Lightning ignition flag |

### Night-sky render state

The night-sky renderers publish their per-frame state for the consolidated
`sky state` log line. The client workers write these; the log and the operator
read them.

| Variable | Subsystem | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `aee_environmental_auroraActive` | environmental | Whether the aurora curtain is drawn this frame |
| `aee_environmental_auroraSourceCount` | environmental | Live aurora particle sources |
| `aee_environmental_milkyWayActive` | environmental | Whether the Milky Way band is drawn this frame |
| `aee_environmental_milkyWaySampleCount` | environmental | Milky Way band samples this frame |
| `aee_environmental_faintStarCount` | environmental | Faint stars drawn by the immediate-mode layer |
| `aee_environmental_effectiveNelm` | environmental | The limiting magnitude the starfield uses (forced when `aee_environmental_starsForce` is set) |
| `aee_environmental_starEmitterCount` | environmental | Bright-star light emitters requested |

### Night-sky debug hooks

Five `missionNamespace` hooks force the night sky for an in-game check. The
consolidated line is greppable by `sky state`.

| Hook | Type | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `aee_environmental_skyForce` | Boolean | Force the whole night sky on |
| `aee_environmental_auroraForce` | Number | -1 off, 0..1 forces that aurora intensity |
| `aee_environmental_milkyWayForce` | Boolean | Force the Milky Way on |
| `aee_environmental_starsForce` | Number | Forced limiting magnitude (6.5 reveals the faint bulk) |
| `aee_environmental_meteorForce` | String | One-shot shower code (spawns one meteor) |

Set a hook from the debug console with the `missionNamespace setVariable`
form:

```
missionNamespace setVariable ["aee_environmental_skyForce", true];
missionNamespace setVariable ["aee_environmental_auroraForce", 0.8];
missionNamespace setVariable ["aee_environmental_milkyWayForce", true];
missionNamespace setVariable ["aee_environmental_starsForce", 6.5];
missionNamespace setVariable ["aee_environmental_meteorForce", "GEM"];
```

Clear every hook and return to the physics:

```
missionNamespace setVariable ["aee_environmental_skyForce", false];
missionNamespace setVariable ["aee_environmental_auroraForce", -1];
missionNamespace setVariable ["aee_environmental_milkyWayForce", false];
missionNamespace setVariable ["aee_environmental_starsForce", 0];
```

### Diagnostics switches

These registered settings gate the DEBUG and TRACE log lines. The
`AEE_LOG_DEBUG` and `AEE_LOG_TRACE` macros test `aee_core_logDebug`, and
per module the name built from the component (`aee_ballistics_logDebug`,
`aee_physiology_logDebug`, `aee_fx_logDebug`). A mission or the debug
console may set any of them directly.

| Variable | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `aee_core_logDebug` | Master switch for DEBUG and TRACE lines |
| `aee_ballistics_logDebug` | Trace shot resolution alone |
| `aee_physiology_logDebug` | Trace the carried load and the item masses |
| `aee_fx_logDebug` | Trace the effect emitters |
| `aee_thermal_logDebug` | Trace the thermal display chain |
| `aee_optics_logDebug` | Trace the optics and eye-adaptation state |
| `aee_nightvision_logDebug` | Trace the NVG tube model |
| `aee_mobility_logDebug` | Trace the mobility model |
| `aee_maritime_logDebug` | Trace the maritime model |
| `aee_atmos_logDebug` | Trace the atmospheric events |
| `aee_armour_logDebug` | Trace the armour ladder |
| `aee_environmental_logDebug` | Trace the consolidated sky state |
| `aee_compat_ace3_logDebug` | Trace the ACE3 integration |
| `aee_compat_acm_logDebug` | Trace the ACM integration |
| `aee_compat_acre2_logDebug` | Trace the ACRE2 integration |
| `aee_compat_kat_logDebug` | Trace the KAT integration |
| `aee_compat_realweather_logDebug` | Trace the Real Weather integration |
| `aee_compat_tfar_logDebug` | Trace the TFAR integration |
| `aee_thermal_agcPinned` | Debug only: suspend the AGC and the engine-window writer so the operator can pin the engine TI window by hand (exposure pin test) |

Every `logDebug` switch registers under **AEE Debug > <component>**. The
coverage-gaps release added one to every addon that declares settings, so
all nineteen sit in one place, grouped by the owning component.

### Human-vision model (perception)

The human-vision model registers its operator switches under **AEE Optics >
Vision** and its colour calibration under **AEE Experimental > Vision**.  The
full list, types and defaults are in the generated configuration chapter.  Each
constant is traced to a published source or marked UNSOURCED in the stringtable
description.

| Variable | Category | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `aee_optics_visionModelEnabled` | Optics > Vision | Enable the physical model for normal vision |
| `aee_optics_visionToneEnabled` | Optics > Vision | Enable the tone and contrast stage |
| `aee_optics_visionToneStrength` | Optics > Vision | Tone-stage strength, 0 to 1 |
| `aee_optics_visionContrastScale` | Optics > Vision | Tone-stage contrast scale, 0.5 to 1.5 |
| `aee_optics_visionWhiteBalance` | Optics > Vision | Enable the partial von Kries white balance |
| `aee_optics_visionAdaptationDegree` | Experimental > Vision | Degree of chromatic adaptation D, 0 to 1 (CIE 159:2004) |
| `aee_optics_visionMesopicDesaturation` | Experimental > Vision | Maximum mesopic desaturation, 0 to 0.5 |
| `aee_optics_visionPurkinjeStrength` | Experimental > Vision | Purkinje tint strength, 0 to 1 |

### Thermal model (band and sensor)

The thermal-realism work adds one operator setting and one runtime variable.

| Variable | Subsystem | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `aee_thermal_activeIR` | thermal | Registered setting under **AEE Thermal > Sensor**: enable the active-IR illuminator (client-local, default off) |
| `aee_thermal_activeIRLight` | thermal | The active-IR light object while the illuminator runs; `objNull` when it is off |

### Exposure pin test (thermal)

`aee_thermal_agcPinned` is a debug-console switch, not a registered
setting.  The AEE Thermal > Display > base channel setting selects how the
thermal display is drawn.  Vanilla TI (the default) draws it on the engine's
own thermal channel; DTV disables the vehicle's native TI and draws it on
the day channel, the route the A3TI and MKK thermal mods use.

The pin test settles whether the engine itself auto-exposes in vanilla TI
mode.  In the debug console type:

```
aee_thermal_agcPinned = true; setTIParameter ["OutputRangeStart", 0]; setTIParameter ["OutputRangeWidth", 1];
```

The switch suspends the AGC and the engine-window writer, so the engine
window stays pinned at the full 0..1 range.  Pan across a cold wall and a
hot engine.  If the image brightness holds, the engine does not auto-expose;
if it brightens and darkens as the hot source fills the view, the engine is
auto-exposing.  `aee_thermal_agcPinned = false` restores the automatic
window.

277 settings register in the CBA settings interface. Three categories carry
the diagnostics and the experimental work: **AEE Experimental > Fusion**
(the four thermal-fusion knobs), **AEE HUD > Displays** (the four on-screen
displays, including the NVG laser target marker), and **AEE Debug >
component** (every diagnostic switch, grouped by the owning component,
including the new AI and Wildlife subcategories). The
remaining categories are one per module: AEE (core), AEE Optics, AEE
Physiology, AEE Environmental, AEE Atmos, AEE Maritime, AEE Radio, AEE
Mobility, AEE FX, AEE Thermal, AEE Armour, AEE Ballistics, AEE Night
Vision, AEE Wildlife, AEE ACE3, AEE ACM, AEE KAT, AEE ACRE2, AEE TFAR, and
AEE Real Weather. The compat categories appear only when their host mod is
loaded.
All settings use `CBA_fnc_addSetting`; titles and descriptions come from
the per-addon stringtables. See the Configuration chapter for the full
table.
